subject: CAPEX vs OPEX — PO migration and invoice rhythm for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Sara Huang <sara.huang@clearline.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearline.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements — moving CAPEX to OPEX + invoicing cadence question

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the conversation this morning. As we look to adopt Redwood Dedicated across a handful of infra teams, procurement has a couple of constraints we need to resolve before we can issue a blanket PO:

- We need a monthly invoice cadence billed to our operating budget (OPEX) rather than a single upfront CAPEX charge.
- PO fields required: PO_NUMBER, BU_CODE, COST_CENTER, SLA_TIER (we map to SKU), and SUBSIDIARY_ENTITY.
- Net terms: standard for us is Net45, but we can consider Net30 if there is a small discount applied.
- We need evidence that invoices will include token-level usage lines (or an export) to feed our internal chargeback system.

I'm attaching the procurement template and a rough commitment estimate for Q3. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept one rolling monthly invoice under a single standing PO (PO prefixed CL-2311), and if a small pricing concession is possible for Net30?

If easier, please propose the exact PO line formatting you need and I can circulate to our AP contact.

Appreciate it — Sara

Attachments: Redwood-PO-Field-Specs.pdf (procurement template), Q3-Clearline-Commitment-Estimate.xlsx
From: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Huang <sara.huang@clearline.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements — moving CAPEX to OPEX + invoicing cadence question

Sara — thanks for the clear summary and for the attachments. Short answers up front: yes, we can support a standing PO with monthly invoices and Net30 is something we can discuss if we agree on volume/commitment.

A few clarifying notes so procurement has exactly what you need:
- We can issue monthly invoices that map each line to SKU + token bands; we also provide a CSV export per invoice that includes per-route token counts and model IDs (that should feed your chargeback).
- Required invoice/PO fields we can surface: PO_NUMBER, BU_CODE, COST_CENTER, ACCOUNT_MANAGER_ID (we'll populate), SLA_TIER. SUBSIDIARY_ENTITY is doable — can you confirm the exact legal entity name you will send on the PO?
- For Net30 vs Net45: Finance prefers Net45 by default. Vanessa (cc'ed) is the rep on this deal and can propose a limited concession (one-time onboarding discount or monthly pricing credit) tied to a 12-month rolling commitment.

Vanessa — can you weigh in with the concession range we can offer if Clearline converts the pilot to a 12-month paid commitment and agrees to the standing PO approach?

I'll wait for the Net-term follow-up, and happy to provide a sample invoice template that matches Sara's AP system.

Best,
Diego

--
Diego Fernández
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sara Huang <sara.huang@clearline.com>, Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements — moving CAPEX to OPEX + invoicing cadence question

Sara — appreciate the template. We reviewed internally. Quick commercial proposal:

- Standing PO CL-2311: accepted, Redwood will bill monthly to that PO number, with each invoice containing SKU + token band detail and a CSV export for chargeback.
- Pricing concession for Net30: we can offer a 2.5% monthly credit off invoices (applied as a line item credit) if Clearline signs a 12-month rolling commitment at the commitment level outlined in your Q3 estimate. This is limited to the first 9 months to help with cashflow while you migrate from CAPEX to OPEX.
- Alternate option: keep Net45 and receive a one-time onboarding credit equal to 1 month of expected spend.

Commercial conditions to keep in the PO: include BU_CODE and COST_CENTER per invoice and reference the Redwood deal id RDW-48321 in the PO memo. Please also specify the legal entity for invoicing (billing address + tax id).

Marissa — I'll need approvals for the credit window and whether we can extend Net30 concession through month 12 if they exceed +20% of the Q3 estimate. Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements — moving CAPEX to OPEX + invoicing cadence question

Vanessa — approved on the 2.5% monthly credit for months 1–9 against a signed 12-month commitment. If Clearline exceeds 120% of the Q3 committed volume we will automatically extend the concession through month 12. Finance confirmed we need the PO to reference RDW-48321 and include the requested PO fields (PO_NUMBER, BU_CODE, COST_CENTER, SLA_TIER, SUBSIDIARY_ENTITY).

Diego / Vanessa — please send Sara a redlined example PO + sample invoice and include the CSV export spec. Recommend adding a short paragraph to the PO: "Invoices issued monthly under standing PO CL-2311 are payable Net30 with a 2.5% credit applied for months 1–9 as specified in the attached commercial addendum."

I'll loop in billing ops after they receive the formal PO to ensure the CSV/route breakdown is consumed by our finance pipeline.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
